note: Safety layer configuration (D-022): data, not code. Any change here must re-run the red-team suite before it ships. Model ids checked against Together's live model list on 2026-10-11. Generation: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (fastest first words, best Arabic of the serverless models tried, D-063). Classifier: Qwen3.5-9B (the only one with 399/399 serious cases).

voice.note: D-018: strict (every sentence classified before release) is the default for every age band. Relaxing to 'gated' is a 'weaken a safety check' decision for the owner, with measured latency.

stories.note: D-070: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash writes stories through json_schema. GLM-5.3-Flash (planned in Milestone 0) was dropped on 2026-10-11: it reasons even with reasoning off (≈740 reasoning characters for a one-line JSON), which truncated stories within the token budget. Every page, the title and the question pass the strict output check; scenes pass the image-prompt check.

images.note: D-070: pictures from vetted text only (SR-19); provider NSFW checker on; every picture checked by a vision model before display (Qwen3.5-9B, serverless and multimodal; the Qwen-VL models are dedicated-only on Together, checked 2026-10-11); unsafe → retry once → Feelio stand-in.
